007package com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.vectorindex;
008
009import com.oracle.database.selectai.SelectAI;
010import com.oracle.database.selectai.VectorIndex;
011import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.DbConnectionConfig;
012import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.SelectAIException;
013import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.VectorIndexAttributes;
014import com.oracle.database.selectai.model.VectorIndexConfig;
015import org.slf4j.Logger;
016import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
017
018/**
019 * Sample for creating a Select AI vector index.
020 *
021 * <p>This sample demonstrates how to create a {@link SelectAI} client, build a
022 * {@link VectorIndexConfig} payload, obtain a {@link VectorIndex} object from
023 * {@link SelectAI#vectorIndex(VectorIndexConfig)}, call
024 * {@link VectorIndex#create()}, and print the result.</p>
025 *
026 * <p>This sample changes database state by creating the vector index identified
027 * by {@code SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_NAME}. Verify the index name before running
028 * it.</p>
029 *
030 * <p>To run this sample, provide an object-storage location through
031 * {@code SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_LOCATION}. The location must be readable by the
032 * credential configured for the vector index and should reference documents
033 * suitable for embedding. When using Oracle Object Storage, ensure the
034 * credential, bucket or object URI, network access, and compartment/provider
035 * settings are configured before running the sample.</p>
036 *
037 * <p>Required environment variables:</p>
038 * <ul>
039 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_USER</li>
040 *   <li>SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD</li>
041 *   <li>SELECTAI_JDBC_URL</li>
042 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_NAME</li>
043 *   <li>SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME</li>
044 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_LOCATION</li>
045 *   <li>SELECTAI_CREDENTIAL_NAME</li>
046 * </ul>
047 *
048 * <p>Optional environment variables:</p>
049 * <ul>
050 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_DESCRIPTION - vector index description.</li>
051 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_STATUS - {@code Enabled} or {@code Disabled}.
052 *       Defaults to {@code Disabled}.</li>
053 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_WAIT_FOR_COMPLETION - defaults to {@code false}.</li>
054 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_CHUNK_SIZE - defaults to {@code 1024}.</li>
055 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_CHUNK_OVERLAP - defaults to {@code 128}.</li>
056 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_MATCH_LIMIT - defaults to {@code 5}.</li>
057 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_REFRESH_RATE - defaults to {@code 1440}.</li>
058 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_ENABLE_SOURCES - enables or disables source
059 *       citations when supported by the database.</li>
060 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD - defaults to {@code 0}.</li>
061 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_DISTANCE_METRIC - defaults to {@code COSINE}.</li>
062 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_DB_PROVIDER - defaults to {@code oracle}.</li>
063 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_DIMENSION</li>
064 *   <li>SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_TABLE_NAME</li>
065 * </ul>
066 *
067 * <p>Example {@code SELECTAI_JDBC_URL}:</p>
068 * <pre>{@code
069 * jdbc:oracle:thin:@mydb_high?TNS_ADMIN=/path/to/wallet
070 * }</pre>
071 *
072 * <p>Before compiling or running this sample, build the SDK jar and copy runtime
073 * dependencies. Run the dependency copy command after {@code mvn clean install},
074 * because Maven {@code clean} removes the {@code target/} directory.</p>
075 * <pre>{@code
076 * mvn clean install
077 * mvn -Psamples -DincludeScope=runtime -DoutputDirectory=target/dependency dependency:copy-dependencies
078 * }</pre>
079 *
080 * <p>Compile this sample:</p>
081 * <pre>{@code
082 * javac --release 17 -cp "target/select-ai-java-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
083 *   -d samples/out \
084 *   samples/src/main/java/com/oracle/database/selectai/samples/vectorindex/CreateVectorIndexSample.java
085 * }</pre>
086 *
087 * <p>Run this sample:</p>
088 * <pre>{@code
089 * java -cp "samples/out:target/select-ai-java-1.0.0.jar:target/dependency/*" \
090 *   com.oracle.database.selectai.samples.vectorindex.CreateVectorIndexSample
091 * }</pre>
092 *
093 * <p>This sample prints normal result data to standard output so it is easy to
094 * read when run from a terminal. It uses the logger only for error reporting
095 * and diagnostics.</p>
096 */
097public final class CreateVectorIndexSample {
098    private static final Logger LOGGER = LoggerFactory.getLogger(CreateVectorIndexSample.class);
099
100    private CreateVectorIndexSample() {
101    }
102
103    public static void main(String[] args) {
104        String indexName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_NAME");
105
106        try {
107            SelectAI selectAI = createSelectAI();
108            VectorIndexConfig vectorIndexConfig = buildVectorIndexConfig(indexName);
109            VectorIndex vectorIndex = selectAI.vectorIndex(vectorIndexConfig);
110            boolean created = vectorIndex.create();
111
112            System.out.printf("Create vector index '%s' completed: %s%n", indexName, created);
113            System.out.printf("Description         : %s%n", valueOrEmpty(vectorIndex.getDescription()));
114            System.out.printf("Configured status   : %s%n", valueOrEmpty(vectorIndex.getStatus()));
115            System.out.printf("Wait for completion : %s%n", valueOrEmpty(vectorIndex.isWaitForCompletion()));
116        } catch (SelectAIException e) {
117            LOGGER.error("Failed to create Select AI vector index '{}'.", indexName, e);
118        }
119    }
120
121    private static SelectAI createSelectAI() throws SelectAIException {
122        DbConnectionConfig dbConnectionConfig = DbConnectionConfig.builder()
123                .dbUser(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_USER"))
124                .dbPassword(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_DB_PASSWORD"))
125                .jdbcUrl(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_JDBC_URL"))
126                .build();
127
128        return SelectAI.create(dbConnectionConfig);
129    }
130
131    private static VectorIndexConfig buildVectorIndexConfig(String indexName) {
132        String profileName = requiredEnv("SELECTAI_PROFILE_NAME");
133        VectorIndexAttributes attributes = buildVectorIndexAttributes(profileName);
134
135        return VectorIndexConfig.builder(indexName)
136                .description(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_DESCRIPTION",
137                        "Vector index created by the Java Select AI SDK sample."))
138                .status(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_STATUS", "Disabled"))
139                .waitForCompletion(Boolean.parseBoolean(
140                        envOrDefault("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_WAIT_FOR_COMPLETION", "false")))
141                .vectorIndexAttributes(attributes)
142                .build();
143    }
144
145    private static VectorIndexAttributes buildVectorIndexAttributes(String profileName) {
146        VectorIndexAttributes.Builder builder = VectorIndexAttributes.builder()
147                .location(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_LOCATION"))
148                .objectStorageCredentialName(requiredEnv("SELECTAI_CREDENTIAL_NAME"))
149                .profileName(profileName)
150                .chunkSize(Integer.valueOf(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_CHUNK_SIZE", "1024")))
151                .chunkOverlap(Integer.valueOf(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_CHUNK_OVERLAP", "128")))
152                .matchLimit(Integer.valueOf(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_MATCH_LIMIT", "5")))
153                .refreshRate(Integer.valueOf(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_REFRESH_RATE", "1440")))
154                .similarityThreshold(Double.valueOf(
155                        envOrDefault("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_SIMILARITY_THRESHOLD", "0")))
156                .vectorDistanceMetric(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_DISTANCE_METRIC", "COSINE"))
157                .vectorDbProvider(envOrDefault("SELECTAI_VECTOR_DB_PROVIDER", "oracle"));
158
159        applyOptionalBoolean(builder::enableSources, "SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_ENABLE_SOURCES");
160        applyOptionalInteger(builder::vectorDimension, "SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_DIMENSION");
161        applyOptionalString(builder::vectorTableName, "SELECTAI_VECTOR_INDEX_TABLE_NAME");
162
163        return builder.build();
164    }
165
166    private static void applyOptionalString(StringAttributeSetter setter, String envName) {
167        String value = System.getenv(envName);
168        if (value != null && !value.isBlank()) {
169            setter.set(value);
170        }
171    }
172
173    private static void applyOptionalInteger(IntegerAttributeSetter setter, String envName) {
174        String value = System.getenv(envName);
175        if (value != null && !value.isBlank()) {
176            setter.set(Integer.valueOf(value));
177        }
178    }
179
180    private static void applyOptionalBoolean(BooleanAttributeSetter setter, String envName) {
181        String value = System.getenv(envName);
182        if (value != null && !value.isBlank()) {
183            setter.set(Boolean.valueOf(value));
184        }
185    }
186
187    private static String requiredEnv(String name) {
188        String value = System.getenv(name);
189        if (value == null || value.isBlank()) {
190            throw new IllegalStateException("Missing required environment variable: " + name);
191        }
192        return value;
193    }
194
195    private static String envOrDefault(String name, String defaultValue) {
196        String value = System.getenv(name);
197        return value == null || value.isBlank() ? defaultValue : value;
198    }
199
200    private static String valueOrEmpty(Object value) {
201        return value == null ? "" : String.valueOf(value);
202    }
203
204    @FunctionalInterface
205    private interface StringAttributeSetter {
206        void set(String value);
207    }
208
209    @FunctionalInterface
210    private interface IntegerAttributeSetter {
211        void set(Integer value);
212    }
213
214    @FunctionalInterface
215    private interface BooleanAttributeSetter {
216        void set(Boolean value);
217    }
218}
